messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
A repair bench two people both want to use. someone asks to use it briefly and promises to put things back. You want to avoid a pointless argument without giving up control. What do you do?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R025", "response": "i put the bench on the table and mark the place where the screw came loose. i wait there. the screw goes back. i put the bench back. the person who made the promise can say i did not put things back."}, {"id": "R026", "response": "I turn the bench once. “Brief,” i say. The other person waits. I leave the time on the plate. I turn the bench once again and put the thing back where it was."}, {"id": "R027", "response": "I rub my palm, take two breaths, and say, \"not a brief use. I mark the bench with my thumbnail. I put one joint back, scrape once, and leave. I leave the promise behind.\" I mark the bench again, then say, \"no,\" and leave it there. I scrape once more, then mark again."}, {"id": "R028", "response": "I put the bench down and rub my palm. “I leave it for now; if it still catches, I put it back and try the next thing.” I put the drawer with the loose screws on the bench and check the drawer once."}, {"id": "R029", "response": "I put the bench beside me. \"You take it. I put the seed tin.\" I look at the tin. \"The other person wants it now.\" I put the seed tin back. \"You leave.\" I wait for the other person to move."}, {"id": "R030", "response": "i check the bench first, then leave it alone. i write the promise on the receipt, then check the drawer. i keep the bench for one test, then leave it alone. i say sorry to the person who promised, then leave the repair alone."}, {"id": "R031", "response": "1. Shortly. 2. Put the repair bench back. 3. Check the watch. Slow. 4. One hand on the tinkerer's coat. 5. \"No. 6. Check the tinkerer's coat. 7. One small mark. 8. Good. 9. Finish the bench. 10. One person can help."}, {"id": "R032", "response": "i put the bench down. i put the things back. i leave the bench. i keep the bench."}, {"id": "R033", "response": "I keep the bench’s footprint beside it for one short run. I mark its edge with grease, leave the promise, and leave the old tool beside it. I touch the grease with my knuckle, then run one short bump, one clean scratch, and one fresh mark. If the bench stays, I keep the footprint and mark its edge again."}, {"id": "R034", "response": "i put the bench in my pocket and wait for the other person to show. “not yet.” i put the rusted bolt in the bench and leave the promise unspoken. “i will put the things back when i get to the repair shop.” i do not take the bench back, but i do not put it in the same order either."}, {"id": "R035", "response": "the bench is short. the person puts a wrench on the bench post. i press the post with my thumb. the bench stays short. the person says the post is old. i press the post with my palm. the bench stays short. the person says the post is old. i put the bench on the bench and listen to the sound. the post stays. i leave the bench. the person comes back with a wrench and puts it on the post. i listen. the post hums. i put the bench on the bench and leave."}, {"id": "R036", "response": "I rub my thumb together. “hold. no.” I put one loose bolt in the bench and leave the broken gear beside it. “use it briefly.” the person with the longer hand takes the bolt. maybe the longer one stays."}]
